```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

# Point reticulate at the Nix py-env (set by T's Quarto build via QUARTO_PYTHON)
quarto_python <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PYTHON")
if (nzchar(quarto_python)) {
  Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = quarto_python)
  reticulate::use_python(quarto_python, required = TRUE)
}

# T sed-replaces read_node("X") with '$T_NODE_X/artifact' (a path string).
# Assign to a variable, then read the file from it. This also tells T about
# the dependency so the report node depends on these upstream nodes.
prices_path   <- read_node("prices")
analysis_path <- read_node("analysis")
history_path  <- read_node("history")
alerts_path   <- read_node("alerts")

prices   <- arrow::read_ipc_file(prices_path)
analysis <- arrow::read_ipc_file(analysis_path)
history  <- arrow::read_ipc_file(history_path)
alerts   <- jsonlite::fromJSON(alerts_path)
```

## Alert Status

```{r alerts-section, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
n_triggered <- sum(analysis$trigger_alert)
callout_class <- if (n_triggered > 0) "callout-warning" else "callout-note"
cat(sprintf('::: {.%s}\n', callout_class))
cat("**", alerts, "**\n", sep = "")
cat(':::\n')
```

## Latest Prices

```{r prices-table, echo=FALSE}
prices |>
  select(token, source, price_usd, price_change_24h, fetched_at) |>
  mutate(
    price_usd = round(price_usd, 4),
    price_change_24h = if (all(is.na(price_change_24h))) NA else round(price_change_24h, 2)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Token", "Source", "Price (USD)", "24h Change (%)", "Fetched At"),
    caption = sprintf("Latest prices for %d tokens (source: %s)",
                      nrow(prices), unique(prices$source)[1])
  )
```

## Depeg Analysis

```{r analysis-table, echo=FALSE}
analysis |>
  filter(is_stablecoin) |>
  mutate(
    deviation = round(abs(price_usd - 1.0), 6),
    status = if_else(depeg_alert, "ALERT", "OK")
  ) |>
  select(token, price_usd, deviation, status) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Token", "Price (USD)", "Deviation from $1", "Status"),
    caption = "Stablecoin depeg check (threshold: 0.005)"
  )
```

## Price History

```{r history-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
n_history <- nrow(history)
n_tokens <- length(unique(history$token))
date_range <- range(as.POSIXct(history$fetched_at, tz = "UTC"))
cat(sprintf(
  "%d observations across %d tokens, from %s to %s.\n",
  n_history, n_tokens,
  format(date_range[1], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"),
  format(date_range[2], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")
))
```

```{r history-write, echo=FALSE}
# Hand off Arrow-deserialized history to Python via parquet (next chunk reads it)
arrow::write_parquet(history, "/tmp/crypto_history.parquet")
```

```{python history-chart-build}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

hist = pd.read_parquet("/tmp/crypto_history.parquet")
hist["fetched_at"] = pd.to_datetime(hist["fetched_at"], utc=True)
hist = hist.sort_values("fetched_at")

tokens = sorted(hist["token"].unique())
fig = make_subplots(
    rows=len(tokens), cols=1,
    shared_xaxes=True,
    subplot_titles=tokens,
    vertical_spacing=0.05,
)

for i, tok in enumerate(tokens, start=1):
    sub = hist[hist["token"] == tok]
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=sub["fetched_at"], y=sub["price_usd"],
            mode="lines+markers", name=tok,
            line=dict(width=2), marker=dict(size=4),
        ),
        row=i, col=1,
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(title_text="USD", tickformat="$,.4f", row=i, col=1)

# Default x-range: last 3 months (per user UI rule)
end = hist["fetched_at"].max()
start_3mo = end - timedelta(days=90)

fig.update_xaxes(
    rangeslider=dict(visible=True, thickness=0.05),
    range=[start_3mo, end],
    row=len(tokens), col=1,
)

fig.update_layout(
    height=200 * len(tokens) + 100,
    title_text="Price History (drag slider to zoom; default = last 3 months)",
    showlegend=False,
    margin=dict(l=40, r=20, t=60, b=40),
    template="plotly_white",
)

fig
```
